title: Chintamani Library v2.8.19 — Clean Update Engine & Full Admin Sync
releaseNotes: Clean In-App Update Engine: Streamlined update dialog with seamless 1-tap download and installation.
Campus Filter Bar: Instant 1-tap filter ([All Campuses], [Khalilabad], [Mehdawal]) in Member Directory.
Member Directory Persistence: Real-time synchronization of Universal QR admissions with active members, subscriptions, and seat assignments.
Payment Verification Approvals: Fixed API routes and methods for 1-tap Approve and Reject actions with full audit sync.
Complaints & Issues Sync: Real-time issue submission and tracking between Universal QR portal, Admin Portal, and Mobile App.
Admin Credential Validation: Automatic production login sync on backend startup.
